$description: Brand knobs: default. PLACEHOLDER values until the brand is designed in Phase 1. This file is the only thing a brand authors; scripts/derive.ts turns it into tokens/generated/default.json.

hue.$description: OKLCH hue (degrees) of the neutral ramp

chroma.$description: OKLCH chroma of the neutral ramp

hue.$description: OKLCH hue (degrees) of the accent ramp

chroma.$description: Peak OKLCH chroma of the accent ramp, before gamut clamping

base.$description: Body text size; step 0 of the type scale

density.$description: Multiplier on every spacing step. Below 1 is tighter, above 1 is airier

decoration.$description: Enumerated: rules | none. Component CSS reacts with container style queries.
